mapper.sql: execution_id, task_code, task_revision_id, task_checksum, dependency_snapshot_json, master_id, business_key, form_id, summary_id, operation, trigger_source, force_flag, status, stage, retryable, result_unknown, retry_count, retry_of_execution_id, last_completed_stage, u8_confirmed, resume_mode, result_outputs_json, dedup_key, trigger_payload, request_payload, response_payload, error_code, error_message, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time

execution_id, task_code, task_revision_id, task_checksum, dependency_snapshot_json, master_id, business_key, form_id, summary_id, operation, trigger_source, force_flag, status, stage, retryable, result_unknown, retry_count, retry_of_execution_id, last_completed_stage, u8_confirmed, resume_mode, result_outputs_json, error_code, error_message, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO int_execution ( task_code, task_revision_id, task_checksum, dependency_snapshot_json, master_id, business_key, form_id, summary_id, operation, trigger_source, force_flag, status, stage, retryable, result_unknown, retry_count, retry_of_execution_id, dedup_key, last_completed_stage, u8_confirmed, resume_mode, result_outputs_json, trigger_payload, request_payload, response_payload, error_code, error_message, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{taskCode}, #{taskRevisionId}, #{taskChecksum}, #{dependencySnapshot}, #{masterId}, #{businessKey}, #{formId}, #{summaryId}, #{operation}, #{triggerSource}, #{force}, #{status}, #{stage}, #{retryable}, #{resultUnknown}, #{retryCount}, #{retryOfExecutionId}, #{dedupKey}, #{lastCompletedStage}, #{u8Confirmed}, #{resumeMode}, #{resultOutputsJson}, #{triggerPayload}, #{requestPayload}, #{responsePayload}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM int_execution WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM int_execution WHERE dedup_key = #{dedupKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM int_execution WHERE retry_of_execution_id = #{executionId}
SELECT execution_id FROM int_execution WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY create_time ASC, execution_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE int_execution SET status = 'SUCCESS', stage = CASE WHEN LEFT(stage, 10) = 'REFERENCE_' THEN 'REFERENCE_COMPLETED' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END, retryable = 0, result_unknown = 0, business_key = COALESCE(business_key, #{businessKey}), request_payload = #{requestPayload}, response_payload = #{responsePayload}, dedup_key = CASE WHEN #{retainDedup} THEN dedup_key ELSE NULL END, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = #{endTime} WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE int_execution SET status = 'FAILED', retryable = #{retryable}, result_unknown = #{resultUnknown}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = #{endTime}, dedup_key = NULL WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE int_execution SET status = 'SKIPPED', stage = 'COMPLETED', retryable = 0, result_unknown = 0, business_key = COALESCE(business_key, #{businessKey}), error_code = 'SKIPPED', error_message = #{reason}, dedup_key = NULL, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = #{endTime} WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE int_execution SET status = 'RESULT_UNKNOWN', retryable = 0, result_unknown = 1, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = #{endTime} WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE int_execution SET u8_confirmed = 1, result_outputs_json = #{resultOutputsJson}, last_completed_stage = #{lastCompletedStage}, stage = #{lastCompletedStage}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE int_execution SET status = 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS', stage = #{lastCompletedStage}, last_completed_stage = #{lastCompletedStage}, result_outputs_json = #{resultOutputsJson}, retryable = 1, result_unknown = 0, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = #{endTime} WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND u8_confirmed = 1

UPDATE int_execution SET status = CASE WHEN stage IN ('U8_REQUEST_SENDING', 'U8_REQUEST_SENT', 'U8_CONFIRMED', 'OA_WRITTEN_BACK', 'START_OA_PROCESS', 'CANCEL_OLD', 'COMPLETED') THEN 'RESULT_UNKNOWN' ELSE 'FAILED' END, retryable = CASE WHEN LEFT(stage, 10) = 'REFERENCE_' THEN 0 WHEN stage IN ('U8_REQUEST_SENDING', 'U8_REQUEST_SENT', 'U8_CONFIRMED', 'OA_WRITTEN_BACK', 'START_OA_PROCESS', 'CANCEL_OLD', 'COMPLETED') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, result_unknown = CASE WHEN stage IN ('U8_REQUEST_SENDING', 'U8_REQUEST_SENT', 'U8_CONFIRMED', 'OA_WRITTEN_BACK', 'START_OA_PROCESS', 'CANCEL_OLD', 'COMPLETED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, dedup_key = CASE WHEN stage IN ('U8_REQUEST_SENDING', 'U8_REQUEST_SENT', 'U8_CONFIRMED', 'OA_WRITTEN_BACK', 'START_OA_PROCESS', 'CANCEL_OLD', 'COMPLETED') THEN dedup_key ELSE NULL END, error_code = CASE WHEN LEFT(stage, 10) = 'REFERENCE_' THEN 'PROCESS_INTERRUPTED' WHEN stage IN ('U8_REQUEST_SENDING', 'U8_REQUEST_SENT', 'U8_CONFIRMED', 'OA_WRITTEN_BACK', 'START_OA_PROCESS', 'CANCEL_OLD', 'COMPLETED') THEN #{afterSendCode} ELSE #{beforeSendCode} END, error_message = CASE WHEN LEFT(stage, 10) = 'REFERENCE_' THEN '进程中断，参照查询未完成，请重新发起查询' WHEN stage IN ('U8_REQUEST_SENDING', 'U8_REQUEST_SENT', 'U8_CONFIRMED', 'OA_WRITTEN_BACK', 'START_OA_PROCESS', 'CANCEL_OLD', 'COMPLETED') THEN '进程中断，外部处理结果未知，请先核对目标系统实际结果' ELSE '进程中断，任务未进入外部发送阶段，可由管理员重试' END, end_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND start_time < #{staleBefore}
